description: This file contains low-level functions for handling internal flash memory operations such as sector size determination, sector erasing, reading, writing, and checking if flash sectors are erased, specific to a microcontroller or embedded system.

methods.name: flashSectorSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a given flash sector based on the sector index.

methods.name: flashSectorBegin
methods.description: Calculates the starting memory address of a given flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorEnd
methods.description: Calculates the ending address of a given flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorAt
methods.description: Determines which sector an address belongs to.

methods.name: flashErase
methods.description: Erases flash sectors covering the specified address range.

methods.name: flashIsErased
methods.description: Checks if a given memory range in flash is erased (all bits set to 1).

methods.name: flashCompare
methods.description: Compares a buffer with flash memory content for equality.

methods.name: flashRead
methods.description: Reads data from flash memory into a buffer.

methods.name: flashWrite
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer into flash memory.

methods.name: flashUnlock
methods.description: Unlocks flash memory for write or erase operations.

methods.name: flashWaitWhileBusy
methods.description: Waits until flash memory is no longer busy with an operation.

methods.name: flashLock
methods.description: Locks flash memory to prevent unintended modifications.
